Meet Kyutai REKI: The 2.4B VLA Model Bringing Efficient Memory to Robot Manipulation
items.text: Kyutai, with Inria and École des Ponts, has released REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) for robot manipulation. The REKI vision-language-action model is pretrained only on public data.
